shortDescription: Manage SNAT pools on a BIG-IP

options.name: description
options.description: An optional description of the SNAT pool.

options.name: members
options.description: List of members to put in the SNAT pool. When C(state) is C(present), this parameter is required, otherwise it is optional. The members can be either IP addresses or names of the SNAT translation objects.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the SNAT pool.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the SNAT pool should exist or not.
